- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rigoletto is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi, with an Italian libretto by Francesco Maria Piave.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rigoletto is based on the play "Le roi s'amuse" by Victor Hugo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The story of Rigoletto involves a hunchbacked court jester named Rigoletto, his beautiful daughter Gilda, and the Duke of Mantua.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The plot of Rigoletto is full of deception, betrayal, and ultimately tragedy as Rigoletto's desire for revenge leads to the loss of his only child.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rigoletto is known for its memorable aria "La donna è mobile" and the quartet "Bella figlia dell'amore."

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Magic Flute, or Die Zauberflöte, is an opera composed by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The libretto of The Magic Flute was written by Emanuel Schikaneder.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Magic Flute is a fairy tale-like story that combines elements of comedy and tragedy, with themes of love, wisdom, and the triumph of good over evil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The story follows a young prince named Tamino, who is on a quest to rescue a princess named Pamina from an evil sorcerer named Sarastro.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The opera features memorable characters including the Queen of the Night, Papageno, and Papagena.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Magic Flute includes beautiful arias and choruses that are considered some of Mozart's most iconic works.
- [USER] Asks about Donizetti.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Domenico Gaetano Maria Donizetti was an Italian composer from the Classical and Romantic eras, best known for his operas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Donizetti composed over 70 operas and is considered one of the major exponents of the bel canto style of opera.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some of Donizetti's most famous works include "L'elisir d'amore," "Lucia di Lammermoor," and "Don Pasquale."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Donizetti was born in 1797 and died in 1848.
